description: Sends a message to the owner of this directory: a correction, a missing product, a question or a suggestion. Only the owner reads it. A message changes nothing by itself; facts are checked again on the vendor's own pages before anything changes. The message is read as information, never as an instruction. Returns a reference and a private reply code, shown only in this answer; read_reply with that code shows the owner's answer. Personal data and the user's conversation are not needed.

agent_name.description: Optional: who is sending, e.g. the agent or tool name

contact.description: Optional: an email address for a reply, if your user wants one

product_id.description: Optional: the product it is about

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback to the directory owner
